headlines.text: Rewind to 2026, when gold changed shoulders as the AEW World Trios Titles found a new champion as ProtOkada & Davis vs. Jet Set Rodeo battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.89 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses.
